title: Common Verbs
description: Learn the most frequently used Tamil verbs — eat, drink, go, come, see, and do.

exercises.explanation: Four essential action verbs — these are the infinitive/command forms used in everyday Tamil speech.

exercises.question: What does 'paaru' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Paaru' means to see or look. 'Paathen' = I saw. 'Paakkiren' = I am looking.
'Pouren' = I'm going (present tense, first person). The root is 'poo' (to go).
'Naan saadam saapiduren' = I am eating rice. Saapiduren = I am eating (present tense).
'Inge vaa' = come here (informal). 'Inge vaanga' = come here (polite).

exercises.question: What does 'pannu' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Pannu' means to do — 'enna pannra?' = what are you doing? 'Enna pannuva?' = what will you do?
'Saapida poomlaam' = let's go eat. Saapida = to eat, poomlaam = let's go.
'Sollu' = tell / say. 'Sollu da' = tell me (casual). 'Sollunga' = please tell me (polite).
